sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia-Navarro, and today I'm interviewing Mirjana Szpoyaric, the president of the International Committee of the Red Cross.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗，今天我采访的是红十字国际委员会主席米里亚娜·斯波利亚里奇。
zh_words: 米里亚娜·斯波利亚里奇

sentences.en: The ICRC works all around the globe and often in secret, remaining neutral to operate in the world's most dangerous environments.
sentences.zh: 红十字国际委员会在世界各地开展工作，而且常常是在保密状态下，通过保持中立来得以在世界上最危险的环境中运作。

sentences.en: But with wars getting more complex due to new technology and world leaders increasingly ignoring the rules of war,
sentences.zh: 但是，随着新技术使战争变得更加复杂，世界领导人日益无视战争规则，

sentences.en: Spoyadich felt compelled to sit down with me to issue a warning about where we all could be headed.
sentences.zh: 斯波利亚里奇感到有必要与我坐下来，就我们所有人可能走向何方发出警告。

sentences.en: We have to understand the significance and importance of the rules of war and why they need to be respected.
sentences.zh: 我们必须理解战争规则的意义和重要性，以及为什么必须尊重它们。

sentences.en: But first, a quick message.
sentences.zh: 但首先，插播一条简短消息。

sentences.en: If you're not a subscriber, we have some news for you.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，我们有个好消息要告诉您。

sentences.en: Just download the app, and we hope you enjoy it.

sentences.en: Okay, on to the interview.
sentences.zh: 好的，进入采访。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for coming in today.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您今天光临。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: This, I know, has been very hectic.
sentences.zh: 我知道，这段时间非常忙碌。

sentences.en: We are meeting just at the end of the UN General Assembly.
sentences.zh: 我们的会面正好在联合国大会结束之际。

sentences.en: I want to start, if you could just briefly tell me, what is the ICRC, and what does it do?
sentences.zh: 我想先请您简要介绍一下，什么是红十字国际委员会，它做些什么？

sentences.en: We are a global organization founded 163 years ago in Geneva, today working in roughly 90 different places across the world, mainly in conflict,
sentences.zh: 我们是一个163年前在日内瓦成立的全球组织，如今在世界各地大约90个不同的地方开展工作，主要是在冲突地区，

sentences.en: because this is what we were created for, to bring help and protection in situations of armed conflict, but then also promote respect for the rules of war.
sentences.zh: 因为这就是我们创立的目的，在武装冲突情况下带来援助和保护，同时也推动对战争规则的尊重。

sentences.en: because with the creation of the ICRC came the founding of the Geneva Convention.
sentences.zh: 因为红十字国际委员会的创立伴随着《日内瓦公约》的诞生。

sentences.en: And then that led to the four Geneva Conventions adopted after the Second World War in 1949.
sentences.zh: 这随后促成了第二次世界大战后于1949年通过的四部《日内瓦公约》。

sentences.en: And still today, this agreement has been ratified by all states because all states agreed that there are red lines in war.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，这项协议仍得到了所有国家的批准，因为所有国家都同意战争有红线。

sentences.en: There are simply certain things that should never be allowed to happen.
sentences.zh: 简单来说，有些事情是绝不被允许发生的。

sentences.en: You know, I covered wars for a big part of my career as a journalist, and the world feels more dangerous and more volatile than I can ever remember.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，作为记者，我职业生涯的大部分时间都在报道战争，现在的世界感觉比我记忆中的任何时候都要危险、更加动荡。

sentences.en: How do you see things?
sentences.zh: 您是怎么看当前局势的？

sentences.en: I see it the same way because the statistics prove it.
sentences.zh: 我的看法是一样的，因为统计数据证明了这一点。

sentences.en: We now count twice as many conflicts as 15 years ago.
sentences.zh: 我们现在面临的冲突数量是15年前的两倍。

sentences.en: We are at 130 international and non-international armed conflicts that we classify in our system.
sentences.zh: 在我们系统中分类的国际和非国际武装冲突达到了130起。

sentences.en: That's the highest number since the Second World War.
sentences.zh: 这是自二战以来的最高数字。

sentences.en: So I think it's time we stop admiring the problem and start acting against this.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，是时候停止仅仅惊叹于问题，而是开始采取行动反对这一切了。

sentences.en: In my own newspaper, there was a recent headline asking if World War III had already begun.
sentences.zh: 在我自己的报纸上，最近有一个标题询问第三次世界大战是否已经爆发。

sentences.en: And I want to speak more deeply about why those fears about a global conflict are taking root.
sentences.zh: 我想更深入地谈谈为什么对全球冲突的这种恐惧正在扎根。

sentences.en: But first, you rarely give interviews.
sentences.zh: 但首先，您很少接受采访。

sentences.en: The ICRC is quite a secretive organization because it has to be because of the sensitivity of what you do.
sentences.zh: 红十字国际委员会是一个相当神秘的组织，因为出于您工作的敏感性，它必须如此。

sentences.en: Why are you sitting down now?
sentences.zh: 为什么您现在坐下来接受采访？

sentences.en: Because I want more and more people to understand that we live in a decade of war.
sentences.zh: 因为我希望越来越多的人理解，我们生活在一个战争的年代。

sentences.en: And because we live in a decade of war, we have to understand the significance and importance of the rules of war and why they need to be respected.
sentences.zh: 正因为我们生活在战争年代，我们必须理解战争规则的意义和重要性，以及为什么必须尊重它们。

sentences.en: These treaties were created precisely for times like the ones we live in.
sentences.zh: 这些条约的创立正是为了我们现在所处的这种时期。

sentences.en: I need to reach out to people.
sentences.zh: 我需要接触民众。

sentences.en: They need to understand the importance of this.
sentences.zh: 他们需要理解这一的重要意义。

sentences.en: Why do you think they don't?
sentences.zh: 您认为他们为什么不理解？

sentences.en: We hear more and more leaders say that the rules of war don't apply anymore because of the pursuit for total victory.
sentences.zh: 我们听到越来越多的领导人说，由于对彻底胜利的追求，战争规则不再适用了。

sentences.en: But that is not possible.
sentences.zh: 但这是不可能的。

sentences.en: In history, there has never been total victory.
sentences.zh: 在历史上，从来没有过彻底的胜利。

sentences.en: There has only been death and destruction over and above what was necessary.
sentences.zh: 只有超出必要限度的死亡和破坏。

sentences.en: Because at the end of the day, whether there is peace always remains a political decision, not a military one.
sentences.zh: 因为归根结底，是否存在和平始终是一个政治决定，而不是军事决定。

sentences.en: Is there such a thing as a necessary war?
sentences.zh: 世上存在所谓的“必要的战争”吗？

sentences.en: As far as I'm concerned, no.
sentences.zh: 就我而言，没有。

sentences.en: But, you know, philosophers and politicians have argued for thousands of years that war is necessary.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，哲学家和政治家们数千年来一直在争论战争是必要的。

sentences.en: But the point is, war has always been considered as something in the pursuit of a political objective.
sentences.zh: 但关键是，战争一直被认为是追求政治目标的一种手段。

sentences.en: You know, it's a means to an end.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这是一种达到目的的手段。

sentences.en: Today, you get the feeling that, you know, the wars become the means to an end itself.
sentences.zh: 今天，你会觉得，你知道的，战争本身成了目的本身。

sentences.en: And they continue because people want to stay in power.
sentences.zh: 它们之所以继续，是因为人们想要掌权。

sentences.en: Because they have created an environment where, you know, the war becomes the condition under which they can continue ruling.
sentences.zh: 因为他们创造了一个环境，你知道的，战争成为了他们能够继续统治的前提条件。

sentences.en: And that's very dangerous.
sentences.zh: 这非常危险。

sentences.en: And you ask me whether we are approaching a third world war.
sentences.zh: 你问我我们是否正在接近第三次世界大战。

sentences.en: Honestly, history will judge that.
sentences.zh: 老实说，历史会对此作出评判。

sentences.en: History books will tell us whether today we already were in the beginning or maybe already in the middle of such a situation.
sentences.zh: 历史书会告诉我们，今天我们是否已经身处这种局势的开端，或者也许已经身处其中。

sentences.en: We didn't know, as the ICRC, that we were in the Second World War when that was happening.
sentences.zh: 作为红十字国际委员会，当第二次世界大战发生时，我们并不知道我们正身处其中。

sentences.en: The awareness of this being one of the most brutal wars in human history, that awareness wasn't there at that time.
sentences.zh: 当时并没有意识到这是人类历史上最残酷的战争之一。

sentences.en: You are one of the few people in the world who regularly travels to both sides of armed conflicts.
sentences.zh: 您是世界上少数几个经常前往武装冲突双方的人之一。

sentences.en: Can you tell me where you've been since you took over as the head of the ICRC in 2022?
sentences.zh: 您能告诉我，自2022年接任红十字国际委员会负责人以来，您都去过哪里吗？

sentences.en: you.
sentences.zh: 您。

sentences.en: I've been to Gaza more than once during military operations.
sentences.zh: 在军事行动期间，我去过加沙不止一次。

sentences.en: My organization facilitated the release and the return of the hostages from Gaza and the Palestinians, the Palestinian detainees back to Gaza.
sentences.zh: 我的组织促成了从加沙释放并返回的人质，以及巴勒斯坦被扣押人员返回加沙。

sentences.en: I was in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我去过乌克兰。

sentences.en: I was in Myanmar.
sentences.zh: 我去过缅甸。

sentences.en: I was recently in Iran, in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 我最近去过伊朗、伊拉克。

sentences.en: I travel to the Middle East often but I also travel to Africa I was in Sudan, I was in Mali I have to go and see for myself what it looks like I need to understand
sentences.zh: 我经常去中东，但我也去非洲，我去过苏丹，我去过马里，我必须亲自去看看它是什么样子的，我需要理解

sentences.en: what civilians endure in conflict because I'm speaking to the holders of power I wouldn't be credible if I didn't know what it is what it means
sentences.zh: 平民在冲突中忍受着什么，因为我在跟掌握权力的人对话，如果我不知道这是什么，意味着什么，我就不会有信誉

sentences.en: to be subject to this level of violence.
sentences.zh: 去承受这种程度的暴力。

sentences.en: I want to start with Gaza.
sentences.zh: 我想从加沙开始。

sentences.en: Your organization is one of the few organizations that has been allowed inside and continues to work in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 您的组织是少数几个被允许进入并继续在加沙工作的组织之一。

sentences.en: You know, international journalists, most other international organizations haven't been given access by the Israeli government.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，国际记者，大多数其他国际组织都没有获得以色列政府的准入。

sentences.en: Can you describe what you have seen?
sentences.zh: 您能描述一下您所看到的一切吗？

sentences.en: I never go to any place of conflict without people telling me that they want to stop.
sentences.zh: 我从未去过任何冲突地点，而人们不跟我说他们想要停止。

sentences.en: Without people telling me that they don't understand why this is happening.
sentences.zh: 没有人们跟我说他们不明白为什么会发生这一切。

sentences.en: I see children without parents.
sentences.zh: 我看到失去父母的孩子。

sentences.en: I see children without arms and legs.
sentences.zh: 我看到失去双臂和双腿的孩子。

sentences.en: I mean, how senseless does the world feel to you when you're confronting these things?
sentences.zh: 我是说，当你面对这些事情时，你觉得这个世界有多荒谬？

sentences.en: And when you then go to the power holders and they tell you that there's nothing that they can do.
sentences.zh: 而当你去找当权者时，他们却告诉你他们对此无能为力。

sentences.en: You just don't understand.
sentences.zh: 你只是不明白。

sentences.en: How is it that I see these children without parents, without limbs, and people who have power and influence still tell me there's nothing we can do?
sentences.zh: 为什么我看到这些失去父母、失去四肢的孩子，而拥有权力和影响力的人仍然告诉我我们无能为力？

sentences.en: I don't understand it.
sentences.zh: 我不明白。

sentences.en: I often don't understand what I see in connection to what I hear.
sentences.zh: 我经常无法将我所看到的与我所听到的联系起来。

sentences.en: Millions of Palestinians who live in Gaza are now forced to live on only around 30 percent of the territory.
sentences.zh: 生活在加沙的数百万巴勒斯坦人现在被迫只能生活在大约30%的领土上。

sentences.en: Over 80% of the buildings in Gaza have been destroyed or damaged.
sentences.zh: 加沙80%以上的建筑物已被摧毁或损坏。

sentences.en: And in a 2025 interview with the BBC during the act of conflict, you called Gaza worse than hell on earth, and you described a people stripped of their human dignity.
sentences.zh: 在2025年冲突进行期间接受BBC采访时，你称加沙比人间炼狱还糟，并形容那里的人民被剥夺了人类尊严。

sentences.en: Have the rules of war been followed there?
sentences.zh: 那里的战争规则得到遵守了吗？

sentences.en: What I said about Gaza is still valid today.
sentences.zh: 我关于加沙的言论在今天依然有效。

sentences.en: What happened to Gaza and in Gaza to Palestinians and Israelis supersedes every legal, moral and humane standards.
sentences.zh: 加沙发生的事情以及加沙境内巴勒斯坦人和以色列人遭遇的事情，超越了所有法律、道德和人道标准。

sentences.en: You know, there's so many people complicit in what happened there and continues to happen.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有那么多的人对那里发生过和正在发生的事情负有共犯责任。

sentences.en: the worst now is the fact that people are deprived of human dignity the perception created that if
sentences.zh: 现在最糟糕的事实是人们被剥夺了人类尊严，制造出这样一种观念，即

sentences.en: there's enough food that's that's good enough for some people it's good enough to just barely
sentences.zh: 只要有足够的食物，对某些人来说这就够了，在瓦砾中勉强

sentences.en: survive in rubble and for other people it's only good enough if they can return to normalcy and
sentences.zh: 生存就够了，而对其他人来说，只有当他们能够恢复正常生活、

sentences.en: bring their children back to a normal school it's applying two standards and this will backfire
sentences.zh: 把孩子送回正常的学校才算够，这是在实行双重标准，而这会产生反效果

sentences.en: We cannot assume that for certain people, certain things are sufficient for a situation when it doesn't apply to everybody else.
sentences.zh: 我们不能认为对于某些人来说，某种情况下的某些东西就足够了，当它不适用于其他人时。

sentences.en: You can see that by how we measure humanitarian needs in Europe in comparison to South Sudan or Somalia.
sentences.zh: 从我们衡量欧洲人道主义需求与南苏丹或索马里的对比中，你就能看出这一点。

sentences.en: Intuitively, and because we can't prevent it, we continue applying to standards.
sentences.zh: 出于直觉，也因为我们无法阻止，我们继续适用双重标准。

sentences.en: That some human lives are more valuable than others.
sentences.zh: 即某些人的生命比其他人更有价值。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I always fear that if you allow double standards, it can happen to you.
sentences.zh: 是的，我一直担心如果你允许双重标准，它也会发生在你身上。

sentences.en: You never know when you find yourself all of a sudden on the other side of the line.
sentences.zh: 你永远不知道自己什么时候会突然发现自己站在了线的另一边。

sentences.en: And it happened in the Second World War to the Jewish people, but it happened to a lot more people than we nowadays keep in mind.
sentences.zh: 这在二战中发生在犹太人民身上，但也发生在比我们今天所能记住的更多的人身上。

sentences.en: I want to stay with Gaza for one more moment before we broaden out.
sentences.zh: 在我们将话题扩大之前，我想在加沙停留片刻。

sentences.en: Did the ICRC have access to the hostages while they were in captivity?
sentences.zh: 红十字国际委员会在人质被囚禁期间接触过他们吗？

sentences.en: Because there were horrific stories of their conditions in captivity.
sentences.zh: 因为有关于他们被囚禁期间状况的可怕报道。

sentences.en: And obviously, that is one of your main roles is to make sure that, you know, detainees, prisoners are treated well.
sentences.zh: 显然，您的主要职责之一就是确保被扣押人员、囚犯受到良好对待。

sentences.en: visiting hostages is much more complicated than bringing them back and in my opinion they should
sentences.zh: 探视人质比带他们回来要复杂得多，在我看来，他们应该

sentences.en: have come back unconditionally as of day one but that's not the reality in which we operate and so
sentences.zh: 从第一天起就无条件回来，但这不是我们运作的现实，所以

sentences.en: we have to work with the tools that we have you know there's nothing more complicated more complex and to a certain extent also more brutal than hostage-taking.
sentences.zh: 我们必须利用手头的工具，你知道的，没有什么比绑架人质更复杂、更错综复杂，在某种程度上也更残酷的了。

sentences.en: We know that also because our own colleagues find themselves more often than they should in such situations.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道这一点，因为我们自己的同事比他们应该的更频繁地发现自己处于这种境地。

sentences.en: And we know how important it is to negotiate them out as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道尽快通过谈判将他们解救出来是多么重要。

sentences.en: So the objective always has to be to bring the hostages back.
sentences.zh: 因此，目标始终必须是带回人质。

sentences.en: And the longer it takes, the more complicated it becomes.
sentences.zh: 拖得越久，事情就变得越复杂。

sentences.en: And I personally think that, you know, pressure should have come earlier on the negotiations.
sentences.zh: 我个人认为，你知道的，应该更早对谈判施加压力。

sentences.en: We could have saved more lives, many more lives.
sentences.zh: 我们可以挽救更多的生命，多得多的生命。

sentences.en: And this was the subject of our conversations.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们对话的主题。

sentences.en: I traveled twice to Qatar to meet with the leadership of Hamas, to sit with Ismail Haniyeh at the time.
sentences.zh: 我曾两次前往卡塔尔会见哈马斯领导层，与当时的伊斯梅尔·哈尼亚坐在一起。

sentences.en: I sat with Prime Minister Netanyahu myself.
